query_plans.label: extension_count
query_plans.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM videos WHERE extension = ?1
query_plans.detail: SEARCH videos USING COVERING INDEX videos_extension_modified_idx (extension=?)

query_plans.label: source_lookup
query_plans.sql: SELECT id FROM videos WHERE source_path = ?1

query_plans.label: sha256_lookup
query_plans.sql: SELECT id FROM videos WHERE sha256 = ?1

query_plans.label: timeline_recent
query_plans.sql: SELECT id FROM videos WHERE extension = ?1 ORDER BY modified_unix DESC LIMIT 100

query_plans.label: inventory_validation_candidates
query_plans.sql: SELECT id FROM videos WHERE ffprobe_ok = ?1 ORDER BY modified_unix ASC, id ASC LIMIT 100
query_plans.detail: SEARCH videos USING COVERING INDEX videos_inventory_default_idx (ffprobe_ok=?)

query_plans.label: inventory_hash_state
query_plans.sql: SELECT id FROM videos WHERE hash_status = ?1 ORDER BY id LIMIT 100
query_plans.detail: SEARCH videos USING COVERING INDEX videos_hash_status_idx (hash_status=?)

query_plans.label: inventory_path_prefix
query_plans.sql: SELECT id FROM videos WHERE relative_path >= ?1 AND relative_path < ?2 ORDER BY relative_path LIMIT 100
query_plans.detail: SEARCH videos USING INDEX videos_relative_path_idx (relative_path>? AND relative_path<?)

query_plans.label: inventory_recent_since
query_plans.sql: SELECT id FROM videos WHERE modified_unix >= ?1 ORDER BY modified_unix ASC LIMIT 100
